#include <string>
#include <sstream>

    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore(); // Ignore remaining newline after reading n
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    line += "_";

    bool in_par = false, in_word = false;
    int word_cnt = 0, word_len = 0, max_len = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        char c = line[i];
        if (in_word && (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')')) {
            in_word = false;
            if (in_par) {
                word_cnt++;
            } else if (word_len > max_len) {
                max_len = word_len;
            }
            if (c == '(') {
                in_par = true;
            }
            if (c == ')') {
                in_par = false;
            }
            word_len = 0;
        } else if (!in_word && !(c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')')) {
            in_word = true;
            word_len++;
        } else if (in_word) {
            word_len++;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            in_par = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            in_par = false;
        }
    }
    std::cout << max_len << " " << word_cnt;
    return 0;
}
